results.title: Why Did PCB Sell Broadcasting Rights at a Loss? Unpacking the Controversy
results.description: The Pakistan Cricket Board has faced a significant setback by selling its broadcasting rights for 25 international home matches at nearly half the reserve price. With only the state broadcaster PTV bidding, the PCB's decision to restrict consortium bids has raised eyebrows. This article delves into the reasons behind this controversial move, including the impact of the national team's recent performance on sponsorship and advertising interest. As Pakistan prepares for upcoming matches against Sri Lanka and a triangular ODI series, the challenges facing the PCB are more pronounced than ever. Read on to uncover the full story behind this broadcasting rights debacle.
